description: ignorePaths replaces the list config:best-practices inherits through :ignoreModulesAndTests, which excludes **/tests/**. That hid tests/Dockerfile, and with it the bats image the whole test suite runs in, from every update Renovate has ever proposed. node_modules and vendor are kept because those are generated trees; tests are code.

packageRules.description: The golang pins outside the Dockerfiles join the same group, so the builder, CI and the documented commands always move to one digest in one PR

customManagers.description: govulncheck, pinned as a plain string in the lint workflow and in the documented commands, where no manager looks. Tracking only the workflow left the documented commands on v1.7.0 while CI moved to v1.9.0

The golang image in the workflows and the documented commands. No manager reads a plain string there, so only the Dockerfiles ever got a new Go, while govulncheck in CI kept scanning against the old standard library and, once Go 1.27.2 fixed five advisories, failed every PR
